get.summary: A page of the Read model, of the Collections the caller can read, filtered and sorted as asked, else in the order of their ids

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Only that Collection's entries, by its key

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: A Content language's code, whose translations are merged into the entries: required when the Project has Content languages, refused when it has none

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Whether to answer how many entries there are in all, as total

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only the entries that pass it, in the filter language of Nexus's Items, each path one step: id, collection, updated_on, or the Query key of a Field the entries' Collections mark to sort and filter by, its own key unless an admin gives it another, a translated one in the Content language queried. A One to Many, Many to Many or Many to Any is tested by the composite ids of the Items it links, with contains-any, contains-all, empty and not-empty. Without collection, a Query key is that of every Collection's Fields marked with it, its own key unless an admin gives it another

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The paths to order the entries by, at most 10, each descending after a -, entries without a value last, then by id: id, collection, updated_on, or the Query key of a Field the entries' Collections mark to sort and filter by, its own key unless an admin gives it another, a translated one in the Content language queried, but a One to Many, Many to Many or Many to Any, separated by commas, such as -updated_on,title

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: The related Items to load in place of their ids, nested, in the same Content language: a depth for every Relation, or a tree of the Relation Fields to load, by key, where true loads one level, a number that depth from there, and an object the Relations of its Items to load, a Many to Any's Collections as 'collection_key:' keys; $limit and $offset in an object page a many-relation's links in their order, never a Many to One's. A Many to Many or Many to Any whose Junction collection has Fields of its own holds its links: each an entry with those Fields and related, the Item it links: the links are a level of their own, the Items they link one further (include=2 loads both), and related is named inside the Relation in a tree ({ "cast": { "related": { "tag": true } } }), a Many to Any's Collections inside related; $limit and $offset page the links, never related. At most 10 levels unless the deployment says otherwise. Related Items of Collections the caller can't read stay ids; those missing from the Read model are left out, a Many to One's null

404.description: There is no such entry the caller can read

bearer.description: An API token's value, or a signed-in User's access token

fields.name: fields
fields.description: What each Item answers, as paths between commas: * for its own Fields that store a value, as by default; a Field's key for that Field; a path through Relations at any depth (author.name, author.*, tags.*, mentions:authors.name, translations:es.title) for the Items they relate; created_by and updated_by go into id and name only; $display for the Item, or one a path reaches (season.$display), shown by its Display template, a Relation's own if it has one.

filter.name: filter
filter.description: Keeps the Items that pass a filter of the filter language, as JSON: { "path": ["author", "name"], "operator": "equals", "value": "Le Guin" }, or { "and": [...] } and { "or": [...] } of them. A Field function tests a part of a date or the count of the links of a many-relation instead of the value: { "path": ["released_on"], "function": "year", "operator": "equals", "value": 2021 }.

sort.name: sort
sort.description: A Field key, a path to one through Many to One Relations and Translations, either wrapped in a part of its date (year(released_on), -month(director.birth_date)), or created_by.name or updated_by.name, after - for descending order; several between commas. By id when left out.

timezone.name: timezone
timezone.description: The IANA timezone, such as Europe/Madrid, the filter, the sort, Display texts and a preview URL read a timestamp's parts in.

search.name: search
search.description: Keeps the Items with a Searchable field that contains it, whatever its case and accents.

language.name: language
language.description: The code of the Content language Translations are read in, by paths, the filter, the search and Display texts; the default one when left out.

display.name: display
display.description: Adds $display: each Item shown by its Collection's Display template, a part of a date in it as a number, a month and a weekday by name in the UI language of whoever calls, English without one.

id.name: id
id.description: Keeps only the Items with these ids.

exclude.name: exclude
exclude.description: Leaves out the Items with these ids.

Filter.description: A test of one Field, or a group of filters of which all must hold (and) or any (or)

function.description: What is tested instead of the Field's value, a whole number: a part of a date (weekday from 1 for Monday), or the count of a One to Many's, Many to Many's or Many to Any's links

UserRef.description: Who created or changed an Item: only their id and name

LinkChanges.description: Moves, then unlinks, then links Items of a One to Many, Many to Many or Many to Any, then changes the values of links' Fields of their own

LinkWrite.description: A linked Item with the values of its link's Fields of their own

TranslationChanges.description: By Content language code, the values of that language's Translation, or null to remove it

$display.description: The Item shown by its Display template, with display=true or $display in fields

release_dates.description: When it first aired in each country.

ContentFilter.description: Only the entries that pass it, in the filter language of Nexus's Items, each path one step: id, collection, updated_on, or the Query key of a Field the entries' Collections mark to sort and filter by, its own key unless an admin gives it another, a translated one in the Content language queried. A One to Many, Many to Many or Many to Any is tested by the composite ids of the Items it links, with contains-any, contains-all, empty and not-empty. Without collection, a Query key is that of every Collection's Fields marked with it, its own key unless an admin gives it another. A test of one path, or a group of filters of which all (and) or any (or) must hold, nested at most 10 deep

value.description: What the operator compares with: none for empty, null and their negations, a list of 1 to 100 for in and not-in, and of 1 to 100 composite ids, such as genres-1, for contains-any and contains-all

sensitive.description: Compares texts telling case and accents apart
